steps: Find the original owner ID, owner-store epoch and request ID in optional receipt references or authorized owner operation listings.
Import preserved records as evidence, not bearer authorization. Reauthenticate to the original owner using independently trusted SSH configuration.
Query the same request and reconcile its accepted or uncertain effects. A changed epoch or missing source requires recovery, not assumed non-execution.

Inspect the exact workflow and retained driver. For a paused local member, stage the closed resume journal command and submit it through workflow.journal.submit or the matching owner workflow journal submit --input-stdin --json command. Preserve the same command_id, canonical command and digest after uncertainty; retrieve the original signed lifecycle journal record through workflow.journal.get and record.read. The owner independently authorizes its native decision and reconciles before reopening admission; explicit participant evidence remains required. Change drivers only through authorized transfer; do not automatically execute imported work.
